title: Acceptance probability of the zero tester
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $w$ be a Boolean string of length $n$. The tester that samples one coordinate uniformly and accepts exactly when the observed value is false accepts $w$ with probability equal to the fraction of its entries that are false.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean string of length $n$
